state.error: Your cart could not be loaded.
state.errorOffline: The server could not be reached, so your cart could not be loaded.
state.actionFailed: That change could not be saved. Your cart is unchanged.

item.unavailable: This product is no longer sold. Remove it to continue to checkout.
item.soldOut: This product is sold out. Remove it to continue to checkout.
item.shortStock: Only {{available}} left in stock. Lower the quantity to {{available}} to continue to checkout.
item.notCounted: This line is not included in the subtotal.

quantity.atStockCap: This is all the stock currently available. Stock is not reserved until the order is placed.

outcome.clampedByStock: Only {{quantity}} of {{product}} are in stock, so the cart now holds {{quantity}}.
outcome.clampedByCap: {{product}} is limited to 10 per order, so the cart now holds {{quantity}}.
outcome.alreadyAtMaximum: {{product}} is already at its maximum of {{quantity}} — the quantity did not change.

blocked.message: One or more products in your cart cannot be purchased right now. Update or remove them to continue to checkout.

shipping.label: Shipping
shipping.qualified: Your order qualifies for free shipping ({{threshold}} or more).
shipping.remaining: Add {{amount}} more to get free shipping (from {{threshold}}).
shipping.qualifiedExcludingUnavailable: Your order qualifies for free shipping ({{threshold}} or more), counted on the {{basis}} of items you can buy right now — items you cannot buy right now do not count towards it.
shipping.remainingExcludingUnavailable: Free shipping starts at {{threshold}}, counted on the {{basis}} of items you can buy right now — items you cannot buy right now do not count towards it. Add {{amount}} more to qualify.
shipping.noDelivery: Collect your order yourself — nothing is shipped, so there is no delivery charge.

merge.merged: Your guest cart was merged into your account cart.
merge.failed: Your guest cart could not be merged into your account. It has not been lost — sign in again to retry.
merge.clamped: Some quantities were reduced to the stock available: {{products}}.
merge.droppedInactive: These products are no longer sold and were removed: {{products}}.
merge.droppedUnavailable: These products are out of stock and were removed: {{products}}.

empty.heading: Your cart is empty
empty.message: No products have been added to the cart yet.
